analysis_plan.arithmetic: exact decimal context (prec 120, Inexact and Rounded trapped)
analysis_plan.carry_premise: unchanged-unless-pushed is an unverified change-feed premise
analysis_plan.clock: one wall/mono anchor at ws_open (meta_pre if never opened), never re-anchored, also used by the capture to end the window; window, liveness, qualification and invalidation are monotonic instants on half-open intervals
analysis_plan.coverage: per route, exhaustive over the window, precedence censored > invalidated > initial > gap > supported

gates.rule: an identical equal-time repeat is ignored without refresh; a changed equal-time or regressed source time, a future or stale frame, or an unusable update suspends the coin until its next accepted frame

analysis_plan.meta_ids: questionUpdated needs uint question and fallbackOutcome and uint lists namedOutcomes and settledNamedOutcomes; outcomeCreated needs a uint outcome; settled ids are uint; otherwise unparsed, which invalidates
analysis_plan.probe: compared with the latest accepted probe-coin bbo received before it: unknown, superseded (bbo time later), match or mismatch; a compared mismatch suspends the probe coin until a later compared match (a new bbo alone does not restore it); two consecutive compared mismatches falsify; unknown and superseded probes leave the streak unchanged; a future, stale, order-failed or unusable probe suspends the probe coin until the next accepted probe

routes.forward: hold complete sets made at par by splitOutcome+negateOutcome (basis 1 per unit); sell every supported member YES that has a bid; immediate cash = sum(bids) - 1; forward_closed (zero residual) only when every member including the fallback is sold; otherwise forward_residual, unsold members valued 0 until observable settlement
routes.inverse_full: buy every member YES at its ask, fallback included, then mergeQuestion; closed cash = 1 - sum(asks); needs every member supported with an ask

analysis_plan.runs: maximal supported positive interval per (route, disposition, sold set); it qualifies iff start + qualifying_min_duration_ms is strictly before its end, so invalidation and support loss win ties; decision attributes use only pieces begun by the qualification instant
analysis_plan.scope: displayed touches only, not takerability, fills, fees, conversion granularity, collateral identity or units; no whole-window or losslessness negative
analysis_plan.state: one causal pass in capture (receipt) order: an accepted frame changes state at its own receipt; nothing is re-sorted, re-applied or backdated; bbo and the l2Book probe keep separate state
analysis_plan.support: every named coin accepted and unsuspended; every required subscription acknowledged exactly once so far; an application message within carry_ms; before the first relevant meta receipt (target or member event, or any unparsed update) and before falsification; the fallback is traded only when supported, otherwise it is unsold residual; inverse_full needs every member supported with an ask
analysis_plan.unattributable: invalid JSON, a missing, non-string, empty, unexpected or error channel, a non-text frame or a bbo without a coin suspends every member until its next accepted bbo

decision_rules.candidate_supported_path: any qualifying run with meta_pre unchanged, every subscription acked exactly once, not falsified and no unlocated meta change; reported per disposition; a displayed-touch bound for a separately frozen timing, depth, fee and conversion review, never execution or profit; forward_residual keeps unsold members as residual claims valued 0 until observable settlement
decision_rules.inconclusive: otherwise, with every reason; runs of any length are listed within the caps
decision_rules.no_qualifying_supported_path: no qualifying run and no reason (uncensored window_closed stop, both meta reads unchanged, acks once, no anomaly, target meta event or falsification, some supported forward coverage); scoped to supported coverage of this window and question, never a whole-window or losslessness negative
decision_rules.unavailable: supervisor denominator when the worker cannot start, is killed, leaves no valid terminal, or its bundle or projection fails: one question, three dispositions, counts null, never zero

planned_host_timer.launch_grant: One run of this exact frozen plan after commit, with --run --plan-sha256. Parent/source pins checked at launch; missed timer or refused launch stays unavailable, no automatic replacement.

premises.P10_bbo_stream: a quiet coin is unchanged rather than lost: an unverified change-feed premise; carried state counts only while an application message arrived within carry_ms; the l2Book probe tests consistency, never losslessness
premises.P11_source_time: bbo/l2Book time is source block time and feeds only the frozen gates; runs, liveness, window and invalidation use the one anchored monotonic receipt clock
premises.P12_initial_state: a coin is unknown until its first accepted bbo; time before the first supported state is initial coverage, never inferred
premises.P1_membership: both outcomeMeta reads reproduce the frozen canonical question structure and no target questionUpdated/questionSettled/member outcomeSettled arrives; tested
premises.P3_conversions: documented splitOutcome, negateOutcome and mergeQuestion at par in the books quote token, fallback included in mergeQuestion; amounts, granularity and fees unverified
premises.P4_merged_book: one YES book per member carries both sides (books-v1 mirrors consistent); not retested
premises.P9_collateral: all members labelled USDC; identity unresolved beyond the label; no USD claim

reads: meta_post after the websocket closes (any stop after meta_pre succeeded)
rest.transport: frozen books-v1 fetch_all: one request each, no retry, redirect or proxy

retention.cap_rule: stop reading once the bundle reaches cap - reserve or raw bytes reach raw_stop; the pending records, stop event and meta_post then fit; a stop is a censored prefix
retention.members: gzip member every 10 s or 32768 raw bytes
retention.retained: every delivered application message, sent frame and connection event, and both REST bodies; protocol ping/pong consumed by aiohttp autoping are not retained

subscriptions: bbo for each member YES coin #<10*outcome>, members ascending
l2Book {coin, no nSigFigs/mantissa/fast} for the lowest named member

window.launch: between open - 900 s and open - 120 s, else refused

storage_request_bytes.note: Existing source is retained under its original categories. Final plan/preflight/host timer and run receipts share65536B control grant; transient service unit files count. No raw compression ratio assumed.

target_note: Q357 chosen before new quotes as the earliest eligible scheduled match; prior books-v1 named-bid margin=-0.00024. No replacement question, retry, reconnect or schedule rescue after any missing/failed result.
